Incidents.ShortDescription: Incident Summary â€“ Power Outage Impact at Tri-Cities Mental Health and Substance Use Centre due to BC Hydro
Incidents.Description:
Hello Team,

Please see below a summary of alerts and events related to the power outage at Tri-Cities Mental Health and Substance Use Centre on January 27, 2026.

Incident Summary:

Multiple alerts were generated indicating a nearby BC Hydro power outage. As a result of the power disruption, the following impacts were observed:

Firewall FH-ELG-02A-R2-FW01 reported alerts and went down. UPS devices (FH-TCMHS-01A-UPS01-EMP and FH-ELG-02A-R2-UPS01) reported battery discharging warnings.

Orion alerts indicated node reboots for firewall and PDU devices.

Thank you,
SOC
